section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale (RSES), a 10-item measure of global self-esteem rated on a 4-point scale. The text notes that the Romanian version of the RSES has demonstrated factorial and convergent validity, and reports Cronbach's alpha coefficients of .87 for women and .84 for men in the present study. This is a methods/measures section that does not contain study-level demographic or outcome data.
